study_id.description: Slug of the llm-d study this round advances. Supplied by the user and confirmed by the coworker; never minted by the specialist, because a round that opens the wrong study deploys real chips against the wrong plan.

workload_spec_path.description: Path to the llmd-workload-spec.json the study optimizes for.

recipe_path.description: Path to the serving-recipe.json of the already-optimized single-replica engine.

mode.description: approve: each cold arm is proposed and waits for the user before it deploys capacity. auto: arms run without asking, only when the user said so and the protocol names a chip-hour bound.

chip_budget.description: Overrides budget.max_chips from the workload spec for this study.

production_namespace.description: Where a promoted release goes. Only read when promotion_approved is true.

promotion_approved.description: The user explicitly approved promoting the incumbent to production in this request. Promotion never happens without it.

examples.prompt: Advance one round of the llm-d study.
